size.summary: How many slots an inventory has.
params: an entity carrying it, or the position of a block containing one
size.returns: `num` — the number of slots, `null` when there is no inventory there.

get.summary: The content of a slot, or of the whole inventory.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: which slot; without it, all of them
get.returns: `list` — the item as `[name, count, nbt]`, or the list of every slot; `null` when the slot is empty.
examples:
// counting what is in a chest
list.reduce(inventory.get(chest_pos), _a + (_ == null ? 0 : _:1), 0);

set.summary: Writes a slot of an inventory.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: the item to put there; without it, only the count changes
optional: the data of the item
set.returns: `list` — what was in the slot before.

find.summary: The first slot holding a given item.
params: the entity or the position holding it
the item to look for; `null` finds the first empty slot
find.returns: `num` — the slot, `null` when there is none.
examples: inventory.find(player, null);            // the first free slot

remove.summary: Takes items out of an inventory, wherever they are in it.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: how many, one by default
remove.returns: `bool` — `true` when everything asked for was taken out.
remove.note: It is all or nothing: with fewer than `count` in the inventory it removes nothing and answers `false`.

has.summary: Whether the inventory holds anything at all.
params: the entity or the position holding it
has.returns: `bool` — `false` when every slot is empty; `null` when there is no inventory there.
examples: inventory.has(chest_pos);   // false for an empty chest
has.note: It is the emptiness check, not a test for particular items. To ask whether something specific is in there use `inventory.find`, and to take it out only when it is all there use `inventory.remove`, which removes nothing when there is not enough.

drop.summary: Throws the content of a slot on the ground.
params: the entity or the position holding it
optional: how many; without it, everything
